# Contributing to Ox of Hephaestus

Please see the [project contribution guide](../CONTRIBUTING.md) and [architecture sketch](../ARCHITECTURE.md) before opening an issue or pull request.

This is an independent spaceship-MUD project based on Evennia. For issues that reproduce in unmodified upstream Evennia, use the [Evennia project](https://github.com/evennia/evennia) instead of assuming they are Ox-specific.
